# List of North West Warriors Twenty20 players

North West Warriors was formed in 2013 and became a Twenty20 team in 2017. They played their inaugural Twenty20 in the 2017 Inter-Provincial Trophy against Northern Knights. In total, 51 players have appeared in Twenty20 cricket for North West Warriors.
Stephen Doheny is North West Warriors' leading run-scorer in Twenty20 cricket, aggregating 723 runs. Jake Egan has the highest score in the format for North West Warriors, with 87 not out scored in 2025 against Munster Reds. For players who have made five or more appearances, Egan and Sam Topping have the teams best batting average: 37.00. Among the bowlers, Andy McBrine has taken more wickets than any other with 54. Craig Young has the best bowling figures in an innings: he claimed five wickets against Northern Knights in a 2017 match, while conceding 15 runs.
Players are initially listed in order of appearance; where players made their debut in the same match, they are initially listed by batting order.
